name: Sentouin Ruka
source:
The principal of Himeshiro Girls' Academy who has a timid personality and always look tired. At the same time, Ruka never gets angry at others. She rarely leaves the principal's office, and as a result, the students are always surprised to see her when she goes through the hallway.

She used to be classmates with [url=/c130992]Remi[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
